History: Cyprus was a Mediterranean island under Roman rule. Barnabas was a Cypriot by birth; men of Cyprus were among the first to preach to Greeks at Antioch; and Paul's first missionary journey began on Cyprus.
Culture: Greek-speaking islanders; Cyprus was famed for copper, from which it takes its name.
Religion: Pagan temples alongside a Jewish community; early Christian preaching reached the island on the first journey.
BibleConnection: Barnabas's homeland; Cyprus was evangelised at the start of the first missionary journey, and Cypriot believers helped found the church at Antioch.
